finding.first_contract: A nearest-guide query with fewer than k eligible guides has no occupied-extent or exhausted-candidate exit; its documented empty-result handling is reached only after traversing the full capped search.
finding.trace: Strands::new(2) admits zero strands. For a nondegenerate one-triangle Surface, Interpolate {count:1, poisson:false, neighbors:4, density:Uniform, patchiness:0, edge:0, ..Default} obtains one root; the edge factor is 1 and it is retained. The guide grid is empty. Interpolate::apply calls nearest_k with k=4 and INFINITY before checking nearest.is_empty. PointGrid caps max_rings at 1,000,000 and visits every ring because found.len() never reaches k. visit_shell enumerates a full (2r+1)^3 cube before filtering each shell. The final ring alone has 2,000,001^3 loop triples. This is finite by source, not mathematical infinity. A supported guide count of 1–3 with neighbors=4 or a group filter that leaves fewer than 4 eligible guides has the same missing early-exhaustion condition.
finding.connected_support: sim.rs:365-405 independently calls nearest_k(...,4,INFINITY) with count=min(settings.guides,total), which can be 1–3 when total is larger; selected source only, no claim about an ordinary runtime caller or scheduling.

Preserve nearest ordering, filters, unbounded-radius mode and original valid guide selection.
